note: Report contexts for the chat evaluation, written by hand from the bundled synthetic samples. Hand-written on purpose: running extraction to produce them would spend two model calls per report and make every chat number depend on how well extraction happened to do that day. The chat evaluation measures chat. Flags here are what FlagCalculator computes from the printed ranges, not what the sample's own FLAG column says - the pipeline recomputes them in code (CLAUDE.md rule 4) and the prompt is given the computed value.
